$description: Figma-side V2 rebind plan. The canonical V2 token source lives in the repository (DesignSystem/source). This file is the executable candidate-diff the design tool needs to apply so the Figma variable collections become a traceable mirror of the canonical source. Applying it requires Figma write access (Variables REST API or manual action by the designer); the desktop MCP used for the audit is read-only, so the design-tool rebind is an isolated external action, not silently assumed done.

legacyCollections.01.primitive: freeze writes; keep as compatibility evidence until the rebind completes

renameRules.pathSeparator: Figma collection paths use '/'; canonical paths use '.'; a/b-c and a-b/c are distinct canonical paths and must not collapse into one CSS/export name (checked by the CSS adapter).
renameRules.backgroundProperty: component token property 'background' that is a plain color becomes 'background-color' in V2; multi-layer backgrounds keep 'background'.
renameRules.inputSizeEnum: input size branch sm/md/lg is renamed to the registered enum small/medium/large in V2.
renameRules.mergedRoles: semantic color border/primary is merged into border/default; nodes bound to border/primary rebind to border/default.
renameRules.productScope: the 17 application-layout variables move out of the public Profile collection into the product-scope package (product/application-layout); they must not be re-exported into the public library.
renameRules.typographyAggregation: semantic typography/font-size/{role}/{variant} and typography/line-height/{role}/{variant} aggregate into typography/{role}/{variant}/{font-size|line-height}.
renameRules.metricSplit: metric/space, metric/border-width, metric/radius, metric/interaction-size, metric/visualization-size become semantic trunks space/border-width/radius/interaction-size/visualization-size; the metric trunk is removed.
renameRules.crossComponentAliases: component-to-component aliases (line-edit->input, select->input, checkbox/radio->selection-control) are re-pointed to their semantic/primitive terminal targets; the 17 cross-family aliases are registered in the legacy map.
renameRules.gradientStops: gradient-stop-01..05 remain registered slots; direction/geometry live in the component drawing contract, not as extra variables.

legacyRuntimeVariables.description: Canvas audit found three legacy variable families still bound on pages beyond the four collections.

var(--component-basic-*).action: rebind to component.* canonical paths (see DesignSystem/config/legacy-map.json runtime role table)

token.*.action: isolate; antd-style leftovers on the Select page, not a ComponentLab token family

DSM/*.action: composite styles (Font/Effect) are regenerated from V2 semantic roles; keep style names, re-point style properties to V2 variables

nodeRebindEvidence.note: The enumeration above is bounded to the audited pages; other pages may carry additional legacy bindings and must be re-audited during the rebind pass.

pendingConflicts.visualization-size: 8 steps diverge between Figma (Standard 16..40, Wide 16..40) and the file export (Standard 16..56, Wide 20..64). Values are kept as the file baseline until a binding consumer verifies the design intent; Wide consumers stay gated. See DesignSystem/config/legacy-map.json pendingConflicts.

rollback.strategy: per-collection freeze + re-run of the legacy import path (DesignSystem/archive/commerly/stoken_import.py) for comparison; V2 generated artifacts regenerate deterministically from the canonical source.
